text: こがねいろに　すき　とおった　きれいな　コハクが　ある！

structure.jp: こがねいろに　すき　とおった
きれいな　コハクが

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こがねいろに　すき　とおった　きれいな　コハク
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a thing describes that thing; the past form here just describes how it looks. こがねいろに　すき　とおった　きれいな　コハク = 'beautiful amber that is see-through and golden'.
